actual_execution_requirements_already_in: Authenticate selected compiler/stock pair/candidate/real literal payloads before execution and recheck afterward; preserve exact macro dylib hashes.

Dylib binary dep-info must name the selected proc_macro and candidate own literal, excluding opposite-arm client. Successful caller binary dep-info must name exact arm dylib. These are new-run checks, not inferred from source.
Success cases need rc0, no errors/warnings and actual metadata; negative cases need rc1, exact expected primary diagnostics and absent metadata.

Retain all raw JSON diagnostics. Reject unexpected non-summary spanless errors as well as extra primary errors; the primary-spans selector must not discard a separate compiler failure. Only explicitly recognized abort-summary records may be excluded from case matching.
Panic recovery remains unproved unless the exact after-panic marker is observed. Expected diagnostic messages/spans are assertions to test, not fabricated results.

findings.result: Uses stable public Ident/Literal/TokenStream/Group/Punct/Span APIs and ordinary thread-local Cell/RefCell. Span start/end/line/column/file are stable since1.88; source_text is stable. No private bridge access, features, mocks, unsafe code or validation bypass is used.

Raw type renders r#type; precomposed café is a valid normalized identifier and exercises non-ASCII server normalization. Literal::string does not escape printable non-ASCII, but escapes newline/quote/backslash, matching REPR. Early Ident/Literal values stay live while96 distinct pairs and8193-byte identifier/literal grow the arena. Their exact strings and locations are then reread. Tuple payloads/numerics/labels are checked in the caller with exact const byte comparisons.

Attribute clones and returns the real item tokens after symbol work. Derive explicitly consumes outer #[...] token groups before the private unit struct and checks complete unit-struct shape. Generated associated constant is consumed by const evaluation. No assumption that derive input lacks attributes remains.

Input identifiers are real source-backed spans; raw identifier source_text includes r# prefix. Nested expansion forwards the original Ident/span into a compiler-scheduled exercise invocation. set_spans recursively assigns the input span while preserving token content. This checks successive expansion, not simultaneous reentrancy.

remember_ident/literal stores a public value in TLS, then emits the matching read_stale invocation. The producing invocation must serialize/return before rustc expands that emitted invocation. Forced same-thread preserves the TLS slot. read_stale takes the value and calls Display; Symbol::get checked_sub then produces the exact use-after-free message after invalidate_all advanced the base. Empty-slot and unexpectedly-survived fallback panic messages differ and cannot satisfy the declared expected error.

deliberate_panic performs symbol work, sets a TLS flag and then panics. after_panic requires and consumes the flag, performs fresh symbol work, then emits a distinct compile_error marker. The outcome is accepted only if both exact diagnostics are observed in this one same-thread compiler process. If compiler ordering differs or skips the second callback, the case fails; it does not assume recovery occurred.

Pinned source default strategy is already SameThread. Explicit same-thread success validates requested selection; it is not a distinct cross-thread qualification. Plan/README preserve default cases and make no cross-thread or synchronous-nesting claim.

diagnose emits compile_error at input identifier span. Compiler proc-macro expansion maps caught panic to proc macro panicked plus message help. Tuple assigned to u8 should yield E0308; String push while an immutable reference remains live should yield E0502 at the generated value span on caller line4. No type/borrow checks are disabled. Actual exact errors remain execution outcomes, not pre-certified facts.

Exactly20 proposed serial compiler children:2 dylib builds plus9 callers per arm. Every caller command/environment/expectation is identical after replacing only the owned arm directory. Macro source is identical; stock uses installed split rlib/rmeta and candidate uses normal candidate rlib plus narrow sibling dependency search. This is semantic comparison, not controlled performance comparison of differently built libraries.

Previous feasibility rechecked all18 original library sources against matching installed sources; only Arena/symbol changed. Candidate d305e270 saved normal-library build and literal dependency are explicit. --extern direct selection and mandatory transitive hash checks preserve actual client linkage. All artifact payload hashes remain saved provenance until launch reauthenticates them; no new current-payload claim is made by this review.
